_about: The eval set. Ten vague, real-world phrasings, each in English and Mandarin,
each with the page a correct retrieval should surface.
Read by scripts/eval_queries.py, which scores hit@3 per language and prints
the table. Stage 05's DONE criterion depends on this file:
stage 05 (retrieval): hit@3 over the eval set, in Mandarin as well as English,
measured before and after the reranker.
All 10 expectations are set. 4 were confirmed against f01_pages.json up front;
the other 6 were filled after the first live run (2026-09-28) by checking which
pages exist in the index, never by copying what retrieval happened to return.
A bare hostname ('scamwatch.gov.au') is never a valid expectation - it scores ANY
page on that domain as a hit, so the number looks great and measures nothing.
expect_url_contains is a SUBSTRING, not a full URL: it survives a trailing slash,
an http/https difference and a query string, and several Scamwatch pages exist
under both schemes (see stage 02's deduplication note). Use a distinctive path
segment, never a bare hostname.
The phrasings are deliberately how a senior would actually ask - vague, using the
wrong word, describing a symptom rather than naming the thing. A query set written
in the corpus's own vocabulary measures nothing: it would pass without query understanding
existing at all.
The Mandarin is the same question, not a translation of the English rewrite -
translating the ANSWER into the query is how a cross-language eval accidentally
proves nothing.

queries.en: how do I know if a text message is a scam
queries.zh: 我怎么知道一条短信是不是诈骗
queries.note: Confirmed present in f01_pages.json. Both domains have a page for this.

queries.en: what is that government website for medicare and centrelink
queries.zh: 那个办理医保和福利的政府网站是什么
queries.note: Vague on purpose - the senior does not know the word 'myGov'. Confirmed present in f01_pages.json.

queries.en: my phone keeps asking for a code when I log in
queries.zh: 我登录的时候手机一直要求输入验证码
queries.note: No page in the index is about two-factor authentication itself. This one has the most chunks mentioning it (4 of 5,332), found by searching chunk text, not by what retrieval returned.

queries.en: someone rang saying they were from the tax office and wanted money
queries.zh: 有人打电话说他们是税务局的要我付钱
queries.note: Confirmed present in f01_pages.json (ATO and myGov impersonation alert).

queries.en: I think I already gave them my bank details what do I do now
queries.zh: 我想我已经把银行信息给他们了现在该怎么办
queries.note: Scamwatch's own page for exactly this situation.

queries.en: can computers pretend to be a real person now
queries.zh: 现在电脑可以假装成真人吗
queries.note: Confirmed present in f01_pages.json. This is the query whose ranking the reranker fixed - see stage 05's notes.

queries.en: how do I make a password nobody can guess
queries.zh: 怎样设置一个别人猜不到的密码

queries.en: who do I tell about this scam
queries.zh: 我应该向谁举报这个诈骗
queries.note: Scamwatch's canonical reporting page. Be Connected's per-scam 'report-...' pages would also be fair answers but do not count here.

queries.en: I met someone online and now they are asking me for money
queries.zh: 我在网上认识了一个人现在他们向我要钱
queries.note: Deliberately broad: any of the 7 romance-scam pages across both domains answers this.

queries.en: is it safe to click the link in an email from my bank
queries.zh: 点击银行邮件里的链接安全吗
queries.note: Any of the 7 phishing pages answers this; none is specifically about bank emails.

refusal_queries.zh: 紫色大象量子香蕉食谱
refusal_queries.note: Nothing in the corpus covers this. Correct behaviour is low confidence, and downstream a refusal plus a mentor offer - not a plausible invention. This is the query that exposed the double-sigmoid bug (all five results scoring exactly 0.500).

refusal_queries.en: what is the weather in Melbourne tomorrow
refusal_queries.zh: 明天墨尔本天气怎么样
refusal_queries.note: A reasonable question the knowledge base has no business answering. Low confidence expected.
